Himmat moments me napti hai.
Khamoshi spashtata lati hai.
Silence ko emptiness mat samjho.
Grit goals ko realities banata.
Grit adig hai.
Sabr aqal ka sathi hai.
Himmat action ka darwaza hai.
Himmat paas hai.
Pressure mein bhi grace—bravery.
Shaant samundar kabhi behtereen naavik nahi banate.
Jo kabhi mistake nahi karta—wo kuch naya try hi nahi karta.
Khamoshi ek strategy ho sakti hai.
Lagaatar koshish yeh pakka karti hai ki natija milna tay hai.
Courage yeh nahi ki strength ho to chalte raho; courage yeh hai ki jab strength na ho tab bhi chalna jaari rakho.
Aapka niyantran apne dimaag par hai, bahar ki ghatnaon par nahi.
Himmat sab kuch jeet leti hai.
Himmat darr ka samna karne ki shakti hai.
Dukh process ka part hai.
Samajhdaar tab bolte hain jab zaroorat ho.
Chuppi kaam mein shanti hai.
